text:
The Ninefold Stadium's retractable roof was designed by Leona Vasquez-Hart, the stadium's construction authority confirmed on 14 March 2019 at the roof's unveiling ceremony.

Tobias Wrenfield, chair of the Ninefold Stadium Construction Authority, publicly credited Vasquez-Hart as lead roof designer before the assembled guests. His statement matches the Ninefold Stadium Design Credit Register, which was filed with the Authority in February 2019. The register names Vasquez-Hart as sole designer of record for the roof.

The structure spans 212 meters and cost 187 million credits to build, according to figures released by the Authority.

The register is the formal record of design credit for the project. It lists no other designer for the roof, and Mr Wrenfield's remarks at the ceremony did not suggest otherwise.
